items.title: American Blocking Domestic Saver Awards Close To Departure (Within Six Days)
items.why: Tighter saver availability lowers redemption value for points-focused cardholders, so expect sentiment to sour on airline-linked earning.
items.summary_ai: American now blocks saver award seats on domestic flights within six days of departure, hitting Alaska and British Airways redemptions hardest.
items.take: Tighter saver availability lowers redemption value for points-focused cardholders, so expect sentiment to sour on airline-linked earning.

items.title: Other Emerald cards miss distinct British Airways benefits
items.why: Benefit gaps across card variants in one family can confuse cardholders and weaken the case for a shared airline partner benefit.
items.summary_ai: InsideFlyer reports that several Emerald card versions do not include certain British Airways benefits.
items.take: Benefit gaps across card variants in one family can confuse cardholders and weaken the case for a shared airline partner benefit.
